sentences.text: Pre-operative multi-sequence MRI: axial T1, contrast-enhanced T1 (T1ce), T2 and FLAIR, co-registered, skull-stripped and resampled to 1 mm isotropic (BraTS preparation).
No necrotic / non-enhancing core exceeds the volume threshold (confidence 0.53). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
The whole-tumour mass is predominantly left-sided (confidence 1.00).
An enhancing tumour component is present (confidence 0.99).
Whole-tumour burden is assessed as medium (volume tercile fitted on the training split; confidence 0.51). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
The enhancing fraction of the whole tumour is mid (ET/WT tercile fitted on the training split; confidence 0.64). This finding is low-confidence and is hedged accordingly.
Acquisition quality (cjv, efc, snr, sharpness, inu, contrast, entropy) is within the range of the training cohort.
T1 and T1ce show a hyperintense lesion with a heterogeneous appearance, while T2 and FLAIR show a hypointense lesion with a more homogeneous appearance.
The lesion has a slightly irregular margin on T1 and T1ce, but is well-defined on T2 and FLAIR.
DEFERRED TO RADIOLOGIST: case confidence 0.53 is below the calibrated gate threshold 0.55.
For radiologist confirmation: ncr_present absent (p=0.53); laterality left (p=1.00).
